summary: A US-Iran military pause drove Brent crude down as much as 7.4% to below $90, easing the inflation shock that had been pressuring bonds and real assets. That relief is running directly into FOMC tension, as the Fed holds rates at 3.50-3.75% with markets pricing roughly a 25-30% chance of a hike at tomorrow's decision, keeping duration under stress and real rates elevated.
tweet: Iran ceasefire cuts oil, but a hawkish Fed decision tomorrow and bruising Big Tech earnings keep bonds stressed and stocks rangebound.
